title: 500 people vibe-coded for 30 days. I was one of them. - Sanja Grbic, Automattic
talk_summary: A product designer at Automattic recounts a 30-day 'radical speed month' where ~500 employees in two-person teams shipped ~794 projects using AI coding tools, and describes how her own process shifted from Figma-first to prototype-first.

takeaways.what_they_do: They start each project as a Claude Code project folder so all chats, ideas, and plans are recorded into the file system, giving both collaborators and later builds a shared, persistent context.
takeaways.evidence_quote: we started the exploration as a cloud code project folder where all of the chats and ideas were recorded into a file system

takeaways.what_they_do: Instead of high-fidelity design before code, they write a plan, build a working prototype directly, and only use Figma afterward for visual fine-tuning and mood boards.
takeaways.numbers: prototype built within a week; ~2.5 weeks to full internal+external deploy

takeaways.what_they_do: They deliberately pair a strong engineer with non-engineers to set up repo, git workflow, and guardrails so weaker members can contribute code safely.

takeaways.technique: Time-boxed autonomy sprint with scoped ownership
takeaways.what_they_do: They pause roadmap work for a fixed window, give small teams full decision authority over a scoped problem, and let each person own one sub-problem end-to-end without handoffs.
takeaways.numbers: ~500 people, ~794 projects in 30 days; one project zero-to-iOS-PoC in 6 days

takeaways.what_they_do: Every employee takes a two-week role-specific AI course with lectures plus focused hands-on time before being expected to use tools in production.
takeaways.evidence_quote: every single employee goes through a two-week course designed specifically for their role. This is completely immersive

takeaways.what_they_do: They expose decades of documented company knowledge to AI tools via an MCP server used for research and planning.
takeaways.evidence_quote: context AC. It's an MCP server that gives AI tools access to all of the knowledge and data that we have documented
